name: Etsy shop opening planner
why: Plans a new Etsy shop's listings, photos, price check and launch steps, before the new listing launch workflow takes over.

name: Monthly catalogue clean-up keeper
why: Finds missing costs, clashing SKUs and hidden products each month, useful before the margin work in the Etsy Ads plan.

name: Product photo set maker
why: Plans and checks a photo set for one real product, which gives Etsy listings a clear first photo, scale and detail shots.

name: Product page image checker
why: Scores product images against a plan and lists one fix per fault, a quick check before the first-photo fixes in the shop audit.

name: Product gallery doubt review and image builder
why: Reviews a gallery against customer doubts and plans images that answer them, using exact product photos only.

name: Review reason spotter
why: Ranks why buyers chose the shop from its reviews, in their exact words, a good source of buyer phrases for tags and descriptions.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: Drafts specific replies to Etsy reviews and lists risky ones; on Etsy, message the buyer before posting a reply to a complaint.

name: Monthly returns and refunds reviewer
why: Finds the products driving refunds and cases each month, which protects Etsy's case-rate standard and Star Seller.

name: Buyer trigger and proof mapper
why: Maps what starts a buyer's search and what proof they need, useful for gift and occasion phrases in tags and sections.
